subject: Code compiles, stuck at first iteration (no error messages)

messages.author: 38a3aacdb5d6f07c
messages.subject: Code compiles, stuck at first iteration (no error messages)
parts:
Hi all,

I am trying to fit a log-linear Poisson multilevel model using Stan.  The model has time and space effects that are at the moment treated as exchangeable (no autoregressive priors yet).  There are 36*31*33 = 36828 data points (36 time periods, 33 spatial areas, 31 = 2^5 - 1 possible observed capture histories for a 5-list capture-recapture).  

The code compiles, and then is stuck here, for many hours:

TRANSLATING MODEL 'CO_code' FROM Stan CODE TO C++ CODE NOW.
COMPILING THE C++ CODE FOR MODEL 'CO_code' NOW.

SAMPLING FOR MODEL 'CO_code' NOW (CHAIN 1).

Iteration:   1 / 1000 [  0%]  (Warmup)

I can't send the data around because it is confidential, but I can send the code (it is likely written in a slightly clunky way because I'm new at this, so I don't vectorize when I should).

Thanks so much!
Shira
